name: FA_SCHEDULE16_REP_T
description: FA_SCHEDULE16_REP_T stores information required by Japanese Corporate Tax Schedule 16 Reports.

columns.name: SCHEDULE16_REP_ID
columns.description: Schedule 16 report record unique identifier.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: COMPANY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the legal entity that owns the assets in an asset book.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique asset book identification name.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date from which the asset information is reported.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date up to which the asset information is reported.

columns.name: REPORT_CODE
columns.description: The name of the report process that populated the data.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Unique asset identification number.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: Category flexfield major category segment value and identification number.

columns.name: STRUCTURE
columns.description: User entered asset structure name of the asset.

columns.name: SPECIFICATION
columns.description: User entered specification of the asset.

columns.name: ONE_TIME_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset is a temporary depreciation asset.

columns.name: DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: The date placed in service of the asset in the tax book.

columns.name: LIFE_YEAR
columns.description: The useful life of the assets in years.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: PROVISION_COMPRESS_AMOUNT
columns.description: The compressed depreciation reserve amount for the asset.

columns.name: COMPRESS_AMOUNT
columns.description: The compressed depreciation deduction amount for the asset.

columns.name: SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value amount for the asset.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: The depreciation limit or the salvage value of the asset in the specified asset book.

columns.name: NET_BOOK_VALUE
columns.description: The net book value of the asset.

columns.name: BASIC_RATE
columns.description: Basic depreciation rate of the flat rate depreciation method.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_DEPRN_SUBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Japan tax legislation article that allows additional depreciation.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Additional depreciation amount of the asset.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_DEPRN_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation rate used to calculate the additional depreciation.

columns.name: SPECIAL_DEPRN_SUBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Japan tax legislation article that allows special depreciation.

columns.name: SPECIAL_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Special depreciation amount of the asset.

columns.name: SPECIAL_DEPRN_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation rate used to calculate the special depreciation.

columns.name: INCREASED_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Increased depreciation amount of the asset.

columns.name: INCREASED_DEPRN_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation rate used to calculate the increased depreciation.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve balance at the end of the period.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT
columns.description: Depreciation limit as a percentage of cost for the asset.

columns.name: DATE_FULLY_RESERVED
columns.description: The date on which the asset was fully reserved in the specified book.

columns.name: DATE_FULLY_RETIRED
columns.description: The date on which the asset was fully retired in the specified book.

columns.name: DEPRN_COUNT
columns.description: The number of periods that the asset has depreciated.

columns.name: NUMBER_PER_FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: The number of periods in a fiscal year.

columns.name: BEGINNING_CORP_NBV
columns.description: Net book value of the asset in the corporate book at the start date.

columns.name: ENDING_CORP_NBV
columns.description: Net book value of the asset in the corporate book at the end date.

columns.name: BEGINNING_TAX_NBV
columns.description: Net book value of the asset in the tax book at the start date.

columns.name: ENDING_TAX_NBV
columns.description: Net book value of the asset in the tax book at the end date.

columns.name: BEGINNING_CORP_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Accumulated depreciation of the asset in the corporate book at the start date.

columns.name: BEGINNING_TAX_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Accumulated depreciation of the asset in the tax book at the start date.

columns.name: CORP_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation amount of the asset in the corporate book.

columns.name: YTD_DEPRN_LIMIT
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation limit amount of the asset.

columns.name: BALANCE_CARRIED_FORWARD
columns.description: The balance carried forward from the prior year.

columns.name: AMOUNT_CARRIED_FORWARD
columns.description: The amount carried forward to the next year.

columns.name: EXTENDED_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset depreciation is extended.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJ_AMT_BEFORE_ALLOC
columns.description: Deprecation adjustment amount before the allocation.

columns.name: GUARANTEE_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation rate that assures a minimum depreciation amount for the asset.

columns.name: GUARANTEE_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation amount calculated for the asset using the guaranteed depreciation rate.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: The adjusted cost of the asset in the specified book.

columns.name: REVISED_RATE
columns.description: Revised depreciation rate of the asset.

columns.name: DEPRECIATION_PERIOD_IN_MONTH
columns.description: The number of period the asset has depreciated in the current fiscal year.

columns.name: REVERSED_COMPRESSED_AMOUNT
columns.description: User entered compressed depreciation reversed amount for the asset in the current fiscal year.

columns.name: PRIOR_CARRIED_DEFICIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: User entered special depreciation deficit carried forward from the prior year for the asset.

columns.name: CURRENT_DEFICIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: User entered special depreciation deficit amount for the asset.

columns.name: CARRIED_FORWARD_DEFICIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: User entered special depreciation deficit carried over to the next year for the asset.

columns.name: PRIOR_NBV_DEFICIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: User entered special depreciation deficit net book value carried forward from the prior year for the asset.

columns.name: DEFICIT_CARRY_OVER_PERIOD
columns.description: User entered special depreciation deficit net book value carried forward from the prior year for the asset.

columns.name: EXPENSED_REVERSAL_COMP_RSRV
columns.description: User entered compressed depreciation reversal reserve for the asset.
